article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Kameron Hobbs had 23 points in Morgan State's 78-74 victory over Norfolk State on Monday night. Hobbs also had eight rebounds for the Bears (8-12, 2-2 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Daniel Akitoby added 15 points, six rebounds and four steals. Ahmarie Simpkins also scored 15. Terrance Jones led the way for the Spartans (12-8, 3-1) with 20 points. Sin'Cere McMahon had 13 points and Brian Moore Jr. contributed 11 points, seven rebounds and five assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
